mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_login_log (user_id, email_input, login_dt, ip, user_agent, success_yn, fail_reason) VALUES (#{userId}, #{emailInput}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{successYn}, #{failReason})
mapper.select:
SELECT l.log_id, l.user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, l.email_input, l.login_dt, l.ip, l.user_agent, l.success_yn, l.fail_reason FROM gw_login_log l LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id
ORDER BY l.login_dt DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_login_log l LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id
